SELECT t.id, t.moment_id, t.user_id, t.reply_to_id, t.reply_to_user_id, t.content, t.created_at, t.deleted_at FROM (SELECT c.id, c.moment_id, c.user_id, c.reply_to_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.deleted_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.moment_id ORDER BY c.id ASC) AS rn FROM im_moment_comment c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.moment_id IN
#{momentId} ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{perMoment} ORDER BY t.moment_id ASC, t.id ASC
